newsitem.title: UK: Stallone keeps media guessing over London wedding.
newsitem.headline: Stallone keeps media guessing over London wedding.

text.p: U.S. film star Sylvester Stallone kept the media guessing on Saturday as to whether he had married his girlfriend Jennifer Flavin in a top-secret ceremony in London.
Stallone, 50, waved and gave a victory fist to fans and photographers outside London's Dorchester hotel where he was said to have made Flavin his third wife.
But asked if the couple had wed, the "Rocky" star simply rubbed his chin quizzically.
Former model Flavin, 28, is the mother of Stallone's eight month old daughter Sophia, who was born with a hole in her heart.
Some media reports said the wedding took place on the rooftop of the Dorchester. But Stallone left the hotel alone with Flavin apparently exiting through a back door.
The couple later drove to Blenheim Palace near Oxford for what was thought to be a blessing in the chapel of the 18th century county house and a lavish reception.
Stallone was reported to have hired 10 bodyguards to protect the wedding party of about 12 close friends.
Stallone's first marriage to Sasha Czach ended in 1985 after 13 years. The following year he married actress Brigitte Nielsen but that lasted only two years.
